what: Two covers hide the page, 60% on top and 40% on the bottom. Along the dotted line of their seam, scissors travel from 7% of the screen to the right edge in 3s (.4 late, power1.inOut), leaving a solid line behind (9% → 102.5%). Meanwhile three number strips roll 0→100 in 3s power2.inOut, and five small wheels under the cover gather from beyond 80vw on the left at 2.8~2.4s, then exit to the right at 2.5~2.1s. Once the cut is finished (3.4s), the two covers fold away upward and downward after .15 in 1.5s power2.in.

options.dur: Length of the scissors’ path (seconds), default 3

use:
Cut along the line
(Curtain, line, scissors, number and wheel are created if missing. When it lifts, fx:done)
note: The curtain uses --kf-contrast-bg, lines·scissors·numbers use --kf-contrast-ink. For screens turned often, like apps, shorten dur·open
